purpose: Bias-aware candidates derived from known human checking; no row is a clean training negative yet.

candidates.location: Fairhope-area context; exact checked shoreline not stated
candidates.reason: Active check observed baby flounder/crabs at the water edge; this is biologically suggestive near-miss evidence, not absence.

candidates.location: Fly Creek to Fairhope Beach search corridor; Fairhope Pier specifically mentioned afterward
candidates.search_effort: explicit plan to look around 3 a.m.; later forum report of nothing by one checker and a possible small event around Fairhope Pier by another
candidates.reason: Different participants reported both nothing and a possible small Fairhope Pier event; preserve heterogeneity rather than collapse to a label.

candidates.claimed_time_or_window: same early-morning window as approximately 06:00 Point Clear reports
missing_before_training: tide/current phase matching to candidate positive/control windows
candidates.reason: Known contemporaneous May Day location check reported nothing, but effort/visibility/time bounds are incomplete.

candidates.claimed_time_or_window: Monday night through after midnight, September 18-19, 1950
candidates.location: Daphne/Eastern Shore beach; exact shoreline segment unresolved
candidates.search_effort: scores of people arrived with lights and equipment; activity continued past midnight
candidates.source_url_or_id: Mobile Press, 1950-09-19, page 2, Jubilee Cry False Alarm; existing visually verified Mobile Public Library scan
candidates.corroborating_source: Fairhope Courier, 1950-09-21, page 8; Monday-night disappointment with equipment ready
candidates.corroboration_treatment: likely same-night corroboration, not a second control or independent biological-absence observation
candidates.reported_observation: Reports yielded a few scattered crabs despite the false-alarm characterization.
missing_before_training: exact shoreline segment and search extent
candidates.reason: The report documents substantial search effort but not biological absence. Keep distinct from the successful September 17 catch and never promote it to a clean negative.

candidates.claimed_time_or_window: Tuesday night; July 11, 1961 calendar-inferred from the July 12 issue
candidates.search_effort: newspaper reports hundreds looked for a Jubilee that failed to materialize
missing_before_training: exact shoreline segment and participant routes
candidates.reason: The issue documents a turnout after nearby Monday and Tuesday positives, but does not bound the watched shoreline or prove biological absence. Preserve as one source/weather cluster and do not use WABF OCR as corroboration.

candidates.target_cell: Eastern Shore; exact failed-call shoreline unresolved
candidates.location: Unresolved; separate from the later Battles Wharf/Montrose positive
candidates.search_effort: newspaper reports another Jubilee cry, followed by a wind shift and a failed call
candidates.reason: A failed call after a reported wind shift documents a claim and likely turnout, not a qualified non-event. Keep separate from the later 04:30-05:00 positive.

candidates.location: Point Clear tip/search area; exact shoreline and route unresolved
candidates.search_effort: first-person author reports searching all Thursday night after a Point Clear tip; a relayed boss also did not find it
missing_before_training: verified search route and shoreline footprint
candidates.reason: The author's party and relayed boss are one source group. The column establishes intentional Point Clear search effort but not a clean negative; keep distinct from the Terry Cove mortality lead.

candidates.claimed_time_or_window: local evening inferred from the August 31, 2011 dated post
candidates.location: Fairhope Yacht Club; exact shoreline footprint unresolved
candidates.search_effort: intentional local check reported in a contemporaneous forum post
candidates.reason: The dated post establishes intentional search effort only. It does not establish a Jubilee, a failed Jubilee, or biological absence.

promotion_rule: A candidate becomes a matched control only after shoreline/time scope, detectability, season, predawn clock window, tide/current phase, and source availability are sufficiently established under matched_control_contract.json.
guardrails: No report is never promoted to a negative.
A scoped negative applies only to the actually checked location/time.
Post-event knowledge cannot leak into pre-event forecast features.
